values.meaning: bonus attack speed per stack of The Relentless Storm (up to 5 stacks)
values.quote: {{as|5%|attack speed}} {{as|(+ 3% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}, up to {{as|25%|attack speed}} {{as|(+ 15% per 100 AP)}}
values.binNote: wiki lists +3% per 100 AP per stack; bin AttackSpeedCalc gives 0.05 base + 0.0003xap which is 0.03% per AP point (3% per 100 AP), matching; the separate tooltip-only calc {ebe98aa3} uses 0.04xap (4% per AP point) which does not match either source and appears to be a stale/unused tooltip value

values.meaning: Lightning Claws bonus magic on-hit damage to target and up to 4 chained enemies
values.quote: {{pp|10+1*x for 3; then + 2*x for 3; then + 3*x for 7; then + 4*x for 7|formula=10+1 per level until lvl 3, then+2 until lvl 6, then+3 per level until lvl 13, then+4 per level}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}} '''bonus''' magic damage
values.binNote: wiki's formula (10,11,12,14,17,20,23,27,31,35,39,43,47,51,55,59,63,67) disagrees with the bin's byLevelL array on ChainLightningDamage (11,12,13,15,17,19,22,25,28,31,34,37,40,44,48,52,56,60); the two sequences diverge at level 1 (10 vs 11) and increasingly beyond level 5, though both use the same 0.45 AP ratio - stating the wiki's number per instructions, this is a genuine data mismatch between sources rather than a transcription error

values.meaning: number of enemies Lightning Claws damage can chain to
values.binNote: BounceCounterMax (5) is shared between max stacks and bounce count logic in the bin; the wiki states the chain applies to the initial target plus up to 4 additional (bounce) targets, consistent with a counter capped near 5

mechanics.claim: Stacks are gained from any basic attack or ability that damages at least one enemy, refreshing the stack duration each time.
mechanics.quote: Whenever '''Volibear''' damages at least one enemy with a {{tip|basic attack}} or {{tip|ability}}, he generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''The Relentless Storm'' for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent damage

mechanics.claim: At 5 stacks Volibear's next on-hit attack (or the ability reaching 5 stacks) is empowered by Lightning Claws, dealing bonus magic on-hit damage that chains.
mechanics.quote: While at four stacks, the next attack or ability on-hit reaching the fifth stack will be empowered by ''Lightning Claws''

mechanics.claim: Lightning Claws damage does not apply to structures or wards.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attacks do not affect {{tip|structures}} nor {{tip|wards}}.

mechanics.claim: A stack is not gained if the attack misses/is dodged while Volibear is blinded, but is still granted if the attack is blocked (parried); Lightning Claws will not apply in the blocked case.
mechanics.quote: A stack of ''The Relentless Storm'' is not gained if the attack is {{tip|dodged}} and/or missed if '''Volibear''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}. A stack is granted even if the attack is {{tip|blocked}}. In all cases, ''Lightning Claws'' will not apply
